_comment: Walk-forward validation of the CURRENT lean_optimizer15m search space (OPT-02). lean_wf_15m searches 30 parameters including qty_pct_equity; the production tree searches 18 and pins qty_pct_equity to 0, so those folds validate a procedure that was replaced and the current production space has no walk-forward evidence at all. This tree exists to produce it: params.json and base_params.json are COPIES of lean_optimizer15m's, and the fold schedule, cost model and eval budget are lean_wf_15m's unchanged, so the only difference between the two trees is the space being searched. It has produced no results yet — running it needs the market data and compute this checkout does not have. lean_wf_15m is kept as historical evidence of the procedure that was replaced, not relabelled.
